scope: 23 remaining 2D letter pictures; preserve existing B/O/K; no engine run, image generation, export or ZIP by this task

shared_style.rendering: Rounded hand-painted toy-like bitmap objects; matte low-gloss materials; gentle upper-left light; simple readable silhouettes; warm cream, sage and tan base palette with semantic colors retained.
shared_style.canvas: Single isolated square RGBA image; target 1024x1024 master, record actual generated dimensions rather than assume them. Existing B/O/K masters are 1254x1254.
shared_style.framing: Optically centered; roughly 75-82% main silhouette extent with 9-12% clear margins; long appendages compact; all outlines inside the canvas. These are generation targets to verify, not claims about delivered pixels.
shared_style.display_contract: Current Content.icon returns 160*raster_scale; story actor draws 112x112, H4 choice max width 66, prologue loads 3x then keeps aspect. Center pivot.
exclude: attached story props except defining parts
semantic_color_exceptions: A red apple and green leaf
shared_style.alpha_policy: Request true transparency, inspect alpha and native background. Preserve original generated sources. Current accepted B/O/K imports use lossless mode and fix_alpha_border=false after strict source-pixel verification.
shared_style.locks: Codebook letter, asset_identity, anchor_en, representative labels, story position/occurrence, learning revisions and saved evidence stay unchanged; decorative candle count, cake tiers, contents and baked sticks are not automatically semantic invariants.

runtime_evidence_boundary: Only hello/nose/book/football currently use bespoke semantic events at H5. Other story actions use ordered keyword-derived categories and labelled meaning-card props; this brief does not claim every authored textual action has a literal animation.
